test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shreya starts walking towards the north from her shop. She walks 15 m, then takes a right turn and walks 30 m. She now takes a left turn and walks 15 m, then again she takes a left turn and walks 15 m. Finally, she turns left again and stops after walking 15 m. In which direction is the end point with respect to the starting point? (all turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
Given, 

1. Shreya starts walking towards the north from her shop and she walks 15 m. Then takes a right turn and walks 30 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2458ad5f837b075818587006b162d653da938f2c5b1e22bba710d07e86a7d75d.png] 

2. She now takes a left turn and walks 15 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45d149322d1d7ac13f329335e7464440a7b6b936f6e08bccb60105c9bdc62a87.png] 

3. Again she takes a left turn and walks 15 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c552e41271514f906813d57906ecddcd41c3ca7ae2cd00f61a17dfbebb6889a5.png] 

4. Finally, she turns left again and stops after walking 15 m.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cb23704b1eb7b0e0162ca19d4ea4fa504f8e2c2a075260be0efc7040c6f7a6.png] 

Final Direction according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cb23704b1eb7b0e0162ca19d4ea4fa504f8e2c2a075260be0efc7040c6f7a6.png] 

She is in **North-east **direction.
